params.script_inline:
import sys, json
doc = json.load(sys.stdin)
d = doc["body"]
envelope = doc["envelope"]
h = envelope.get("header") or {}
hop = h.get("hop") or {}
ctx = h.get("context") or {}
route = str(hop.get("route") or "")
finish = str(hop.get("finish_reason") or "")
reason = str(hop.get("reject_reason") or "")
if route == "reject" and reason in ("quote_missing", "quote_not_in_source"):
    # A quote of a sidecar section that did not stand where the composite's
    # knob `sidecar_verify` says it must (GH #1079): `./curator` refuses the
    # item and says which section, which field and why -- never the item's
    # words, because a drain is no place to file what the model claimed the
    # person said, and a class is all a count needs. Told apart by the check's
    # own two codes: the keeper's refusal below carries a `reject_reason` too
    # (`store_refused`, gh343) and is untouched.
    session = str(hop.get("session_id") or ctx.get("session_id") or "")
    turn = str(hop.get("turn_id") or ctx.get("turn_id") or "")
    section = str(hop.get("section") or "")
    field = str(hop.get("field") or "")
    text = ("talky reject: source=sidecar_verify reason=%s section=%s field=%s session=%s turn=%s"
            % (reason, section, field, session, turn))
    sys.stdout.write(json.dumps([{
        "header": {"route": "error", "error_code": reason, "error_source": "sidecar_verify",
                   "session_id": session, "turn_id": turn, "reject_reason": reason,
                   "section": section, "field": field,
                   "episode_turn_id": str(hop.get("episode_turn_id")
                                          or ctx.get("episode_turn_id") or "")},
        "messages": [{"origin": "assistant", "type": "text", "text": text}]}]))
    sys.exit(0)
if route == "reject":
    # The session-keeper's store refusal (GH #343). It is not a failed
    # inference, so it carries no finish_reason -- and its code sits in
    # hop.store_error, because the cell that reports it did not itself fail:
    # the store it spoke to did.
    source = "session-keeper"
elif finish:
    source = "brain"
else:
    source = "unknown"
code = str(hop.get("error_code") or hop.get("store_error") or finish or "error")
session = str(hop.get("session_id") or ctx.get("session_id") or "")
turn = str(hop.get("turn_id") or ctx.get("turn_id") or "")
text = "talky error: source=%s code=%s session=%s turn=%s" % (source, code, session, turn)
sys.stdout.write(json.dumps([{
    "header": {"route": "error", "error_code": code, "error_source": source,
               "session_id": session, "turn_id": turn},
    "messages": [{"origin": "assistant", "type": "text", "text": text}]}]))

reject_reason.description: GH #1079: on a refused quote, why -- `quote_missing` or `quote_not_in_source`; also the `error_code`

section.description: GH #1079: on a refused quote, the sidecar section it was in

field.description: GH #1079: on a refused quote, the first field of the item that failed

episode_turn_id.description: GH #1079: on a refused quote, the person's episode of the turn the section annotated

description.purpose: The composite's ONE error drain port: three failure lanes from two cells -- the brain's error and its content filter, the session-keeper's store refusal -- fan in here and leave as one normalised report on route error, so a parent tree drains a single edge instead of three lanes. Since talky@4.3.0 (GH #447) the summarizer's failed summary is not one of them any more: the composite carries no summarizer. Since GH #1079 a fourth lane fans in: `./curator`'s refusal of a quoted field that did not stand in its source (the splitter's knob `sidecar_verify`), source `sidecar_verify`.
description.use_when: Inside the talky composite. The parent MUST wire the exit somewhere - a log sink, an alarm, an operator surface; an unwired error lane dead-letters, which is loud but not actionable.
description.not_in_scope: No retry, no judgement, no swallowing: what a failure means is the parent's decision. Deliberately NOT a drain cell - a drain that ends inside the unit would make the failure invisible to the tree that owns the agent.
description.emits_meaning: route error: one report per failure, naming source (brain or session-keeper), error code, session and turn. For a keeper refusal the code is the STORE's error_code, read off hop.store_error -- the keeper itself did not fail, the store it spoke to did (GH #343). The report carries NO conversation content on purpose - the llm error lane echoes the PROMPT back, and a drain is not the place to file it. For a refused quote (GH #1079) the source is `sidecar_verify`, the code the `reject_reason` (`quote_missing`, `quote_not_in_source`), and the report names section, field and the person's episode beside session and turn -- never the item's words.
description.consumes_meaning: the brain's error / content_filter emission (finish_reason on the hop) and the session-keeper's reject emission (route on the hop, hop.store_error / hop.store_operation beside it). Anything else is reported as source unknown rather than swallowed. And `./curator`'s reject emission with `hop.reject_reason` beside `section`, `field`, `session_id`, `turn_id`, `episode_turn_id` (GH #1079); any other reject is the keeper's, `reject_reason` `store_refused` included.
examples: provider 500 at the brain -> one report, source brain, code error
the session store refuses the nightly sweep -> one report, source session-keeper, code query_timeout
a quote of a sidecar section the person never said -> one report, source sidecar_verify, code quote_not_in_source, no words
